name: opennomark-desktop
author: OpenNoMark contributors
description: Desktop distribution for the OpenNoMark local watermark remover

scripts.prepare:backend: uv run --frozen --project .. --extra api --extra desktop pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath backend-dist --workpath ../build/pyinstaller ../packaging/opennomark-backend.spec
scripts.prepare:offline-models: uv run --frozen --project .. --extra api python ../packaging/prepare_offline_models.py download --output bundled-models
scripts.verify:offline-models: uv run --frozen --project .. --extra api python ../packaging/prepare_offline_models.py verify --output bundled-models
scripts.prepare:desktop: npm run prepare:frontend && npm run prepare:backend
scripts.dist:win:offline: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run prepare:offline-models && npm run verify:offline-models && electron-builder --config electron-builder.offline.cjs --win nsis
